tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje theg pa'i gnas lugs gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs kyi ye shes las byung ba'i sngags dang*/ de'i cho ga lam gyi gtso bor ston pa la/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di ni theg pa gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul spyir mang du yod kyang gtso bo ni las tshogs dang*/ dngos grub bsgrub tshul dang/ lha dang*/ sngags dang*/ lus la gnad du bsnun pa sogs/ theg pa gzhan la med pa'i thabs mang ba ste/ slob dpon tri pi ṭa ka mā las mdzad pa'i tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*/ /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes thabs mang bar bshad pa la sogs pa'o/ / zhan yang gsang ba mdzod kyi rgyud las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye shing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun dag na/ /ma bsgom par yang sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nus pa nas skye ba bdun nam bcu drug gam/ bya rgyud lta bur ma mtha' shin tu thogs kyang bskal ba brgyad kyis sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i phyir lam myur ba ste/ gsang 'dus las/ sems can mtshams med la sogs pa/ /sdig pa chen po byed pa yang*/ /rdo rje theg pa rgya mtsho che/ /theg pa mchog ni 'di la 'grub/ /ces gsungs shing*/ yang de nyid las/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /brten na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /yang der ma zad/ bka' thub dang dka' spyad mi dgos par 'dod yon gyi bde ba bsten pas dngos grub 'grub pa sogs bde bas sangs rgyas thob pa'ang yin te/ thabs mang ba dang*/ dus myur ba dang*/ 'jug pa bde ba ste khyad chos gsum po 'di'i sgo nas/ theg pa gzhan thams cad las mchog tu 'gyur pa yin no/ /de la dbye na rgyud sde gnyis dang*/ gsum dang*/ bzhi dang*/ lnga dang*/

drug la sogs pa'i bar du dbye ba yod pa las/ gtso bor rgyud sde bzhi yin la/ de'i nang tshan rgyud sde dang po bya rgyud la dbye na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ padma'i rigs/ rdo rje rigs te 'jig rten 'das pa'i rigs gsum dang*/ nor bu'i rigs dang*/ lnga rtsen gyi rigs/ 'jig rten phal pa'i rigs ni 'jig rten pa gsum ste/ de ltar rigs drug go /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la dam tshig gsum bkod/ tshe dpag med/ mi 'khrugs pa/ sman bla sogs sangs rgyas dngos rnams gtso bo'i rigs yin la/ 'jam dpal gyi rigs rnams rigs kyi bdag po dang*/ gtsug gtor rnam rgyal gdugs dkar dri med sogs rigs kyi gtsug gtor dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dang*/ phyag rdor 'khor bcas ma gtogs/ byang sems rnams rigs kyi sems dpa' dang*/ sangs rgyas spyan ma/ gzungs grwa lnga la sogs pa rigs kyi yum dang*/ gshin rje gshed ni rigs kyi khro bo dang rig pa'i bdag po dang*/ mi g.yo ba la sogs pa rigs kyi pho nya dang*/ 'phags ma 'od zer can ma dang*/ ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma sogs dang*/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan dang*/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang*/ phyir bzlog chen mo la sogs pa rigs kyi pho nya mo yin no/ /padma'i rigs la/ rigs kyi gtso bo 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yin la/ bcom ldan ma gos dkar mo sogs rigs kyi yum dang*/ sgrol ma sogs rigs kyi lha mo dang don yod zhags pa dang*/ ha la ha la sogs rigs kyi sems dpa' dang*/ rigs kyi bdag po zhes bya ba rigs kyi khro bo ni rta mgrin no/ /ral gcig ma la sogs pa rigs kyi khro mo dang/ srin mo ral gcig ma dang*/ dpal chen mo la sogs pa ni rigs kyi pho nya mo'o/ /rdo rje'i rigs la/ rigs kyi gtso bo phyag na rdo rje/ rigs kyi yum lha mo mā ma kī dang me ltar rab tu rmongs byed/ rdo rje mi pham mo la sogs pa'o/ / rigs kyi sems dpa' ni khro gnyer rim par ldan la sogs pa yin yang khro bo'i khongs su 'dus/

rigs kyi khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ rigs kyi pho nya stobs po che la sogs pa/ rigs kyi pho nya mo rdo rje lcags sgrogs ma la sogs pa drug cu rtsa bzhi yod par gsungs/ nor bu'i rigs kyi rgyud ni/ gnod sbyin nor bu bzang pos bshad pa ste/ dzambha la dang nor rgyun ma la sogs pa'i rgyud do/ /lnga rtsen gyi rigs ni/ gnod sbyin lnga rtsen nyid dang*/ 'phrog ma dang*/ bu dga' byed la sogs pa'o/ /'jig rten pa'i rigs la tshangs pa/ dbang phyug khyab 'jug zla ba/ nyi ma/ mkha' lding rnams gtso bor bshad cing spyir lha klu gnon sbyin/ dri za mi'am ci/ lha ma yin/ mkha' lding*/ 'byung po ste sde brgyad kyi rigs mtha' yas pa rnams so/ /de ltar bya ba'i rgyud kyi rigs kyi dbye ba rnams bshad nas/ rjod byed tshig gi rgyud la dbye na/ mdo sde dang*/ rgyud dang*/ rtog pa dang*/ cho ga zhib mo dang*/ gzungs te lnga yod/ dang po ni/ gser 'od dam pa lta bu cho ga bsdus shing sa lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag mang ba gcig la zer/ gnyis pa ni cho ga rgyas shing sa lam bsdus pa spyi rgyud gsum dang zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs la sogs pa'o/ /spyi rgyud gsum pa ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud dang*/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa dang*/ legs grub kyi rgyud gsum mo/ /gsum pa ni/ gnod sbyin ma'i rtog pa lta bu cho ga'am sgrub thabs kyi rnam grangs gcig kho na zhib mor ston pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang*/ phyag na rdo rje rig pa mchog gi rgyud sogs cho ga dang*/ sa lam gnyis ka rgyas par bstan pa'o/ /lnga pa ni gzungs sngags phan yon dang bcas pa tsam ston pa 'od zer can ma'i gzungs la sogs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i bya rgyud kyi nyams len lam gyi rim pa ni/ smin byed kyi dbang la chu dang cod pan gyi dbang tsam las med cing*/ de yang bya rgyud rang lugs kyi slob dpon gyi go 'phang thob phyir du bskur ba dang*/

sngags bsgrub pa'i don du slob ma'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ bar chad zhi ba'i don du dbang bskur ba dang*/ 'byor ba thob pa'i phyir du dbang bskur ba ste/ dgos pa'i dbang gis phyai bas dbang bskur tshul bzhi yod/rgyud 'dir rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba kho na bshad/ grol byed kyi lam la mtshan bcas mtshan med gnyis kyi dang po la/ bdag bskyed kyi lha'i rnal 'byor med cing*/ mdun bskyed la yang dam tshig pa bskyed pa med de/ ye shes kyi lha spyan drangs phyag rgya bstan/ mchod pa phul te sngags bzlas nas mthar gshegs su gsol ba tsam yin/ gnyis pa ni stong pa nyid bsgom pa ste/ mdo dang thun mong ba kho na'o/ / grub pa 'bras bu'i dus ni/ rgyud sde 'dir zhugs na dbang po rnon pos bskal pa brgyad nas sangs rgyas thob par bzhed/ drag po'i las thob pa'i skabs 'ga' dang*/ khro bo 'chol pa stobs po che bsgrubs pa la sogs pa dmigs bsal can rnams ma gtogs khrus dang gtsang sbra dang snyung gnas la sogs pa'i dka' thub dang*/ mchod rdzas kyang srog chags kyi lus dang ma 'dres pa gtsang ma kho na dgos par bzhed cing*/ bsnyen pa dang bsgrub pa'i dus tshangs spyod dge bsnyen yad chod kyi spyod pa la brten dgos pa dang*/ rgyud kyi nang sel re re tsam las mdun bskyed lha pho mo phan tshun gzigs pa la bsgrub pa rang nyid phar lta ba'i chags lam tsam bshad do/ /rgyud sde gnyis pa sbyod ba'i rgyud ni/ phyi'i bya ba dang nang gi rnal 'byor cha mnyam du spyaud pas spyod pa'i rgyud ces bya zhing rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir gnyis ka'i rgyud ces kyang zer ro/ /'di la dbye na rigs gsum ste/ sku'i rigs dang*/ gsung gi rigs dang*/ thugs kyi rigs so/ de la sku'i rigs ni/ rigs gsum gyi gtso bo yin la/ bod du 'gyur ba'i dbang du byas nas spyod rgyud mtha' dag gi gtso bo'am rtsa bar gyur ba rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud yin cing*/

de las lha'i rnam grangs mang po ston kyang gtso bo sangs rgyas rnam snang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs can sku mdog ser po phyag mnyam gzhag mdzad pa cig gsungs/ bya rgyud du sangs rgyas rnams rang byung chags bral gyi rnam pa kho nar bshad/ 'di nas brtsams te rgyud sde gong ma rnams su sangs rgyas zhi ba sku rgyan dang ldan pa dang*/ khro chags kyi sku la sogs pa ma nges pa mang du gsungs so/ /de ltar na rigs kyi gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ rigs kyi khro bo mi g.yo ba brtul phod pa'i rgyud dang*/ gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la gsung gi rigs ni bod du ma 'gyur/ gsum pa thugs kyi rigs ni phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud yin la/ 'di las lha'i rigs mang du bshad kyang*/ gtso bo phyag na rdo rje zhi ba yin/ 'od zer can ma lha mang gi rgyud 'di bod du sngar bya rgyud du grags kyang rang lugs spyod rgyud yin pas sku'i rigs su bsdu dgos/ ngan song sbyong rgyud kyang rnal 'byor rgyud yin par grags kyang*/ rang lugs spyod rgyud yin/ dkyil 'khor sku gsung thugs 'dres par bstan pas/ rigs gsum ka 'dres pa'i rgyud du 'gro zhing 'di las dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis bshad pa'i rtsa ba ni kun rig yin no/ /de ltar spyod rgyud kyi dbye ba bshad zin nas/ nyams len gyi rim pa ni smin byed kyi dbang*/ grol byed kyi lam grub pa 'bras bu'i dus te gsum las/ dang po ni/ phal cher bya rgyud dang 'dra ba las/ mig thur me long gi dbang bskur sogs mtha' rten lhag po dang spyod rgyud kyi nang nas rigs mtho ba 'ga' zhig la chu cod pan phyag mtshan rdo rje dril bu lta bu dang*/ ming gi dbang bdag po'i dbang sogs yod pas/ rig pa'i dbang lnga rjes mthun pa yod/ grol byed lam la mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor gyi skabs su bdag nyid lhar bsgom pa yang yod cing mdun bskyed la yang dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bsre ba'i skabs kyang yod pa dang*/

ji skad du/ rgyud las/ dang por khrus byas rnal 'byor bas/ /rdo rje'i gdan la 'dug nas ni/ /mchod dang gsol ba lha drug bsgom/ /stong dang yi ge sgra gzugs dang*/ phyag rgya mtshan ma drug tu 'dod/ /ces 'byung ba ltar/ phyi nang gi khrus sngon du 'gro ba'i bsrung 'khor bsgom pa dang*/ ye shes kyi lha spyan drangs te phyag rgyas btab nas mchod pa 'bul/ gsol ba btab/ de rjes gnas lugs kyi don bsgom pa stong pa'i lha/ de'i ngang las sngags kyi yig 'bru dang sa bon bsgom pa yi ge'i lha/ sngags kyi sgra dang bcas pa'i 'od zer spro bsdu bsgom pa sgra'i lha/ lha'i sku gzugs sgaum pa gzugs kyi lha/ thugs kar phyag mtshan sogs bsgom pa phyag rgya'i lha/ rang lus la sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pas lha skur bsgom pa mtshan ma'i lha zhes lha drug gi rnal 'byor gsungs so/ /mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor la yang snying gar phyag mtshan dang yig 'bru bsgom pa dang*/ rlung srog rtsol dgag pa dang*/ lha pho mo rgod pa'i 'dod chags lam byed sogs bya rgyud las lhag pa'i khyad chos yod/ spyod pa gtsang sgra la gnas pa dgos kyang dmigs bsal re tsam ma gtogs dka' thub dka' spyad mi dgos te/ bdag nyid lhar sgom dgos pa'i phyir ro/ grub pa 'bras bu'i dus ni/ bskal pa chen po gsum nas sangs rgyas thob nus par bshad la/ 'bras bu ji ltar bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni/ 'di dang bya rgyud gnyis 'dra ste/ spyod pa bzhi zhes bya ba/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa dbang dang dam tshig rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa rnal 'byor gnyis la brten nas bsnyen pa byed pa/ sgrub pa'i spyod pa rnal 'byor pa dmigs pa la brtan pa thob nas/ bris sku'am dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa la mchod cing bsgrubs pas dngos sam rmi lam du lha'i snang ba 'byung ba/ sgrub pa chen po'i mchod pa so so'i rgyud las 'byung ba ltar las tshogs dang dngos grub bsgrub pa'o/

/rgyud sde gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud la rtsa rgyud ni de nyid bsdus pa yin/ 'di'i dum bu dang po nas rdor dbyings/ gnyis pa nas khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal/ gsum pa las 'gro ba 'dul ba/ bzhi pa las don yod grub pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams ston/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo yin/ 'di yang rgyas bsdus ma gtogs dkyil 'khor ston tshul snga ma dang phyogs 'dra/ yan lag gi rgyud thams cad gsang ba dang*/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi sgos rgyud cig kyang yod/ cha mthun gyi rgyud dpal mchog dang po yin/ rgyud 'di las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dpal mchog rigs bsdus su grags pa 'di yin la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /yo ga rigs bzhi zhes kyang grags rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu la rigs bzhi yod pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/ rgyud so so ba rang ni med/ rgyud kyi dbye ba ni thabs rgyud shes rab rgyud gnyis su byed/ dpal mchog shes rab kyi rgyud yin/ gzhan rnams thabs rgyud do/ /yo ga'i skor la lugs srol mang po byung yang gsum po 'di grags che ste slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen dang*/ sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*/ kun dga' snying po'i lugs so/ /de gsum las kyang phyi dar la kun snying kho na'i lugs dar ro/ /'di'i lam gyi dbang du byas na/ smin byed kyi dbang gi dus su chu cod pan/ rdo rje dril bu/ ming dbang rdo rje'i brtul zhugs/ rdo rje slob dpon te bum dbang bdun gyi mtha' rten dang bcas bla med phyogs 'dra rung yod/ grol byed kyi lam la lha'i rnal 'byor mngon par byang chub lnga bskyed pa sogs dang bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yang yod/ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bstim nas phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab byed/ dbang blangs te bzlas brjod byed pa sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba sbyangs nas dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa'i bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa las sbyor rgyas par gsungs/

lag bcangs bde ba lam byed dang*/ mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor yang spyod rgyud dang 'dra rung ba las zab khyad thon pa yod/ grub pa 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyang dbang po rnon pos tshe gcig nas rtul pos skye ba bcu drug tshun chod la phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par bshad/ de nas kyang lam la 'bad pas mi ring par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub ste shin tu thogs kyang bskal pa chung ngu gcig la mthar thug gi sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ro/ /rgyud sde bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla med la dbye na/ pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis yod cing*/ de yang rnal 'byor bla ma'i rgyud dang thabs rgyud dang pha rgyud skabs 'gar rnal 'byor chen po rnams don gcig cing*/ skabs 'gar rnal 'byor bla med ces pa'ang ma rgyud kho na la 'jug pa'i skabs yod/ spyir nas shes rab kyi rgyud dang ma rgyud dang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud rnams don gcig go /de gnyis kyi khyad par thabs dkyil 'khor lha yab gtso bor gyur pa'i bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag dang sngags dang cho ga gtso bor ston cing*/ shes rab lha mo'i sngags dang cho ga mchog bsgrub pa'i don du mi ston pa de ni thabs rgyud yin la/ thabs rgyud kyi khyad chos rnams shes rab kyi rgyud la tshang zhing*/ thabs rgyud la med pa'i gnad mang po yang shes rab kyi rgyud la yod pas/ thabs rgyud las shes rab kyi rgyud zab bo/ /des na shes rab rdo rje lha mo'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sngags dang cho ga rgyas par ston pa de ni ma rgyud ces bya ste/ 'di la yang yab yum cha mnyam par ston pa dang*/ yum gyi rigs shas cher ston pa ste rigs gnyis yod do/ /gzhan dag thabs snying rje dang*/ shes rab stong nyid/ thabs spyod pa dang*/ shes rab lta ba/ thabs sgyu lus dang*/ shes rab 'od gsal/ thabs bskyed rim dang*/ shes rab rdzogs rim/ thabs snang ba bzhi dang*/ shes rab dag pa bzhi ston tshul gyi sgo nas 'byed par 'dod pa dang*/

gzhan yang sku'i rnam 'gyur rgyan cha lugs rtsa dang rlung sogs kyi sgo nas dbye ba mdzad pa dang*/ pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis thabs shes phyogs re dang*/ gnyis med kyi rgyud thabs shes zung 'jug yin zer ba sogs 'dod tshul skyon dang bcas pa yin pas rang lugs la mi bzhed do/ /de las pha rgyud la dbye na 'dod chags kyi rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ zhe sdang gi rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ gti mug gi rigs kyi rgyud do/ /dbye ba 'di rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rgyan gyi rgyud las bshad/ dang po ni/ gsang 'dus yan lag dang bcas pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag dang*/ gdong drug pa dang*/ gshed dmar dang*/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba la sogs pa'o/ /dang po gsang 'dus la rgyud kyi dbang du byas na rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ rgyud phyi ma dang*/ bshad rgyud kyi rigs la dgongs pa lung ston rdo rje 'phreng ba/ lha mo bzhis zhus pa la sogs pa'i/ dgongs 'grel mkhan po slob dpon so so'i lugs srol ltar na/ spyir rgya gar yul du gsang 'dus la lugs nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod par grags/ bod du 'gyur ba la 'phags bskor zhes bya ba klu sgrub lugs/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi lugs/ slob dpon shanti pa'i lugs/ rdo rje bzhad pa'i lugs/ padma badzra gyi lugs/ kun snying gi lugs te drug go /de'i phyi ma ni rgya gar mkhas pas bkral ba tsam yin yang*/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud yin nges pa zhig phyis yo ga'i tshul du bkral ba yin pas mkhas pa chen po rnams mi 'thad par bzhed/ gzhan rnams lugs rnam par dag pa yin no/ / dang po 'phags lugs ni dbang chog nyi shu pa/ sgrub thabs mdo byas/ rdzogs rim rim pa lnga dang*/ spyod bsdus sgron me/ 'grel pa sgron gsal dang bcas pa'i skor rnams yin/ sngon slob dpon klu sgrub mi yul du mngon sum par bzhugs shing*/ tshogs gsum gyi bstan bcos mdzad pa'i skabs gdul bya dus la ma bab pa 'di rnams gzhan la dngos su ma grags/

klu'i byang chub ces bya ba'i slob ma gcig kho na la bshad/ de grub pa thob nas 'chi ba med pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs la/ phyis klu sgrub sku 'das nas lo bdun brgya tsam lon pa na klu'i byang chub dngos su mjal ba'i slob dpon ma taṅgi pa dang*/ rgyal sras pa 'dres pa gnyis las rgya cher 'phel zhing dar ba yin/ gnyis pa ye shes zhabs lugs ni/ bod kyi rgyal po mes ag tshom can khri lde gtsug brtan gyi dus tsam na slob dpon 'di byung ba yin/ 'dis slob dpon seng ge bzang po dang 'jo sgeg rdo rje dang*/ rnal 'byor ma gu ṇe ru dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dza ti dza la dang*/ slob dpon byis pa'i zhabs dang*/ grub thob srung ba'i zhabs rnams bsten/ thun mong gi dngos grub dang nus mthu dpag tu med pa thob/ da dung gnas lugs ma rtogs te sgrub pa mdzad pas/ 'jam dbyangs kyis rjes su 'dzin par lung bstan/ sa phyogs zhig tu 'phags pa 'jam dpal nyid khyim btsun rig ma dang bcas pa'i tshul du gzigs/ gsol ba btab pas 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor dngos su gyur te dbang bskur/ gdams pa bstan/ ye shes khyad par can brnyes/ zas dang spyod pa dang cha byad gsum la ma dad pas lus gnas ma gyur/ bar dor sangs rgya bar lung bstan/ bi kra ma la shī la'i rab gnas dang*/ rdo rje gdan mchod pa dang*/ nā landa btul ba dang*/ gnod gnas dbang pos yon bdag byed pa sogs che ba sogs che ba dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i slob dpon des/ 'jam dbyangs kyi gsung la zin bris 'jam dpal zhal lung bsdus/ sgrub thabs kun bzang*/ rdzogs rim grol pa'i thig le sogs mdzad/ rjes 'brang so sos rgyud bshad 'grel pa rigs mi gcig pa mdzad pa mang du yod/ dngos slob mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ba 'ja' lus ye shes kyi sku thob pa bzhi byung ste/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ padma 'byung gnas/ rab zhi bshes gnyen/

rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin no/ gzhan rgyal tshab kyi sa la gnas pa zhes bya ba bskyed rim la brtan par thob/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'i slob ma bco brgyad byung*/ 'phags zhabs kyi lugs 'di gnyis rgya bod gnyis kar du shin tu dar la/ slob dpon rab zhi ye shes kyi 'grel pa sogs zhabs lugs cung zad tsam/ snga 'gyur gyi dus su yang byung*/ phyi dar la lo chen rin chen bzang po dang*/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ gnyos lo tsā ba yon tan grags/ lo tsā ba ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs kyis cung zad dar bar mdzad/ 'phags lugs ni bstan pa snga dar la ma byung phyi 'gyur la lo chen rin chen bzang po dang*/ 'gos khug pa/ lho brag mar ba/ chag lo sogs kyis dar bar mdzad cing*/ bar skabs su 'gos kyi slob brgyud sdog ston yab sras rnams kyis shin tu dar bar mdzad/ gsum pa shānti pa'i lugs la/ 'grel chen snyim pa'i me tog tsam zhig 'gyur ba dang*/ bzhi pa rdo rje bzhad pa'i lugs ni snga dar gyi dus lce bkra shis dang ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur/ lnga pa padma badzra gyi lugs la rgyud don nyams len gyi rim pa gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzhung nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur/ 'di gsum la dbang bshad man ngag ring du ma dar bar mngon/ rgyud zla gsang thig le dang*/ rdo rje snying rgyan/ nor thig rnams rgyud tsam zhig 'gyur ro/ /gshin rje gshed nag po dang*/ gdong drug dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed de nag po skor gsum du grags pa la/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags dang*/ skyo 'od 'byung dang*/ zhang lo shes rab bla ma dang*/ gnyos lo tsā ba dang*/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs te lo tsā ba lnga po de las brgyud pa da lta'i bar ma nub pa yod/ gzhan rong zom chos bzang dang*/ ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa sogs sngon dus lugs gzhan yang mang du byung*/ rgya gar du la lī ta badzra chung ba dang*/

a mo gha badzra che chung dang*/ grub thob dpal 'dzin dang*/ slob dpon 'jam dpal ye shes la sogs pas bstan bcos mang du mdzad mod/ lugs srol tha dad pa'i dbye ba ma byung ngo*/ /de las dgra nag gdong drug gnyis 'dod chags kyi rgyud du gtogs la/ 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ni zhe sdang gi rigs kyi rgyud yin par rtog pa bdun pa nyid las bshad do/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba ni bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su 'gyur la phyi 'gyur rgyud 'grel gnyis tsam lo chen gyis bsgyur/ gzhan phyi dar la 'gyur byed ma byung*/ gti mug gi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ spyir 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba yin cing*/ bod du 'gyur ba la mtshan brjod phan yon dang bcas pa kho na'o/ /'di dngos bla med kyi pha rgyud yin yang rgyud kun gyi bdag por gsungs pas slob dpon so sos sna tshogs su bkral te byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis dus 'khor gyi lugs su bkral la/ paṇḍi ta 'jam dpal grags pa dang*/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis yo gar bkral/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes bla med pha rgyud du bkral/ gzhan yang bod dang rdzogs chen dang rgya gar du dbu mar bkral ba sogs kyang yod par grags so/ de ltar pha rgyud rigs gsum po de dag mtshan dang mthun pa'i brjod bya ston tshul so sor yod de 'dus pa sogs bskyed rim gyi skabs su yab yum kha sbyor gyi sku dang*/ zhu ba glus bskul ba dang*/ 'khor tshogs yum gyi mngal nas spro ba sogs dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs su las rgya rig ma bsten pa gtso bor 'chad pa sogs chags lam gtso bor ston/ gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs pa dang*/ drag po mngon spyod cung zad tsam las rgyas par mi 'byung*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed lta bu zhe sdang gi rgyud las ni lha'i rnam pa yab rkyang gtso bo dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs kyang rlung dbu mar 'gog pa'i thabs rang lus gtso che ba dang*/

drag po mngon spyod kyi las kho na rgyas par 'chad/ mtshan brjod lta bu gti mug gi rigs kyi rgyud la lha yab rkyang ngam kha sbyor yod du chug kyang zhu ba glus bskul dngagag 'khor rnams mngal 'byin med cing*/ gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi gnas tshul rgyas par 'chad/ rdzogs rim kyang rnam par mi rtog pa nyid gtso bor 'don/ drag las dang chags lam sogs zur tsam ma gtogs rgyas par ma gsungs pas/ dbye ba de ltar shes dgos kyi kha cig rnam snang sgyu dra gti mug dang*/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag zhe sdang rigs kyi rgyud du 'dod pa sogs rgyud rang rang gi brjod bya'i don dang mi mthun/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud la pha rgyud dang ma rgyud/ rigs gnyis ka yod/ le'u bcu dgu pa ni pha rgyud yin/ chags can gyi rgyud du gtogs/ le'u nyer gnyis pa ni ma rgyud he ru ka'i phyogs su gtogs pa'i dbye ba shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ma rgyud la dbye na/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs/ he ru ka'i rigs/ rtag pa'i rigs/ rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs/ padma gar dbang gi rigs/ rta'i rgyal po'i rigs te drug yod pa las/ dang po ni dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la sogs pa yin te/ dus 'khor rgya gar yul du shin tu dar yang rgyud dang 'grel pa gnyis ka zhal gsal bas lugs srol mi 'dra ba med/ slob dpon dus zhabs pa chen po 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang*/ slob dpon tsi lu pa dang/ pi ṭwa a tsaraya gsum so sos re re zhing shambha la nas spyan drangs pa la sho lo ka re re gnyis gnyis mang nyung yod zer/ bod yul 'dir snga phyir lo tsā ba so sos bsgyur bas 'gyur mi gcig pa nyer bzhi tsam yod par grags/ de dag las rwa lo chos rab/ 'bro lo shes rab grags/ chag lo chos rje dpal/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags/ bi bhū ti tsand+ra las brgyud pa gsum la dbang bshad man ngag gsum ga yod la/ rdzogs rim sbyor drug ni/

lugs srol bcu bdun tsam rgyud ma chad par bzhugs/ rgyud 'di las dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis gsungs te sgrub le las sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ ye shes le'u las/ sdom chen sdom chung gnyis/ gsang 'dus lha dgu ma/ bcu gsum ma/ bcu bdun ma/ nyer lnga ma/ so gnyis ma/ so bdun ma ste gsang 'dus rigs drug sgyu 'phrul dra ba zhe gcig ma/ zhe lnga pa/ zhe dgu pa ste rigs gsum/ de ltar bcu gnyis so/ /de rnams kyi nang sel phye ba shin tu mang*/ sdom pa chung ba ma gtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gcig po de sdom pa la dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor zhes zer ro/ /sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud ni/ snga dar gyi dus su slob dpon hūṃ ka ra dang*/ thu bo ra dza ha ti la sogs pa dang*/ lo tsā ba lha rin chen dang*/ dran pa nam mkha' la sogs pas bsgyur/ phyi dar la lo chen rin bzang gis bsgyur/ 'di la rgya gar gyi yul du lugs srol gnyis tsam byung ste/ brgya byin sdong po'i lugs dang*/ bram ze rin chen rdo rje'i lugs gnyis bod du yang 'gyur ro/ /'di las dkyil 'khor rigs drug kar ston kyang*/ gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' yin pas/ rdor sems kyi rigs su bsdu/ /gnyis pa he ru ka'i rigs ni 'khor lo bde mchog dang*/ dges pa rdo rje dang*/ ma hā ma ya dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa dang*/ phyag chen thig le rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa dang*/ a ralli'i rgyud gnyis dang bcas pa rnams yin la/ de las 'khor lo bde mchog la rgyud kyi dbang du byas na/ rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud gnyis/ bshad rgyud kyi nang nas sdom pa 'byung ba/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnams la dbang bka' re re yod cing*/ a bhi dha na'i nang nas gsungs pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur drug 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ bong zhal can/ mchog gi phag mo sogs dbang bka' mang du yod/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod dang*/

he ru ka sngon byung la sgos bka' med/ thun mong gi bshad rgyud sambu ṭa'i kha sbyor rdor sems dang he ru ka bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang rgyun yod/ kun gyi rtsa ba rtsa rgyud kyi dbang bshad man ngag gsum la spyir lugs srol shin tu mang ba yod par grags shing*/ rgya gar gyi grub thob shas che ba zhig rgyud 'di'i grub thob yin par grags pa dang*/ bod du yang lo dril nag gsum/ laṅka rgyal bzang*/ rin chen rdo rje/ mi thub zla ba/ bha ba bha dra/ shar phyogs lwa ba pa/ phyag rdor stod 'grel gyi lugs/ stong nyid ting 'dzin gyi lugs rnams 'gyur yod/ dang po gsum dang*/ phyag rdor stod 'grel lugs la da lta'ang dbang rgyun yod mod/ gtso cher rgya bod gnyis kar du shin tu grags che ba'i lugs srol ni/ lū yi ba/ dril bu pa/ nag po pa'i lugs gsum yin la/ de'i dang po ni/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong du nye ba tsam na rgya gar du slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med byon pa dang rags rtsis su dus mnyam pa/ bod yul du chos kyi dbu bsnyengs pa'i rgyal po lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan dang yang dus mtshungs pa tsam la slob dpon lū yi ba byon/ 'di u rgyan gyi rgyal po'i yig mkhan yin/ dang po'i bla ma grub thob shā bā ri pa yin cing*/ rgya gar shar phyogs bhaṃ ga lar nya'i rgyu lto gsol zhing sgrub pa mdzad pas rgya skad du lū yi pa bod skad du nya lto bar grags/ grub pa brnyes nas yul la u ḍi bi sha'i rgyal po dang blon po rdzu 'phrul gyis btul/ phyis rgyal pos grub pa thob pa dha ri ka pa ste 'khor khri drug stong dang bcas pa 'ja' lus thob/ blon po grub pa thob pa ni ḍi ṅgi pa ste 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa 'ja' lus brnyes so/ /slob dpon lū yi pa 'dis bde mchog gi sgrub thabs tsam zhig mdzad/ de la lā ba pas 'grel pa mdzad/ rgya bod thams cad du shin tu dar shing 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos tshul chu mgo lta bur grags

so/ /'di'i mtshan saṃskṛ ta'i skad du lū yi pa dang*/ zur chag gi skad lo i pa yin/ lu hi pa zer ba ma dag go /gnyis pa dril bu lugs ni/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu par grags pa 'di/ dang po grub thob dha ri ka pa'i slob ma yin/ mtshan dngos blo gros snying po'i dpal zhes bya/ mu stegs pa'i rgol ba 'joms nus pa'i mkhas pa yin pa las rdo rje phag mos dngos su lung bstan/ o ḍi bi sha'i yul du bsgrub pa mdzad tshe/ dang po rgyal pos spyan drangs pa la ma byon/ phyir rig ma dang bcas par gyur pa la skye bo rnams ma dad pas de rnams 'dul ba'i don du khye'u gcig dang*/ bu mo gcig sprul/ lan cig grong khyer du de dag bcas te byon pas skye bo rnams kyis smad pa na/ rwa'i gshor zhal sa la brdabs pas sa 'og nas chu byung*/ khye'u rdo rjer byas/ bu mo dril bur song de gnyis phyag gnyis su bsnams slob dpon yab yum bde mchog lhan skyes kyi rnam par gyur nas nam mkha' la gshegs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pas mtshan yang rdo rje dril bu par grags/ de nas brtsams te sngags kyi theg pa'i 'gro don mdzad/ slob dpon 'dis bde mchog lus dkyil sgrub thabs/ dbang chog rdzogs rim rim lnga rnams mdzad de slob ma yang grub pa thob pa mang du byung ngo*/ /gsum pa nag po lugs ni/ shing rta'i srol 'byed slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i 'di ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma dang*/ mgon po mngon 'byung las lung bstan te/ dus 'khor las/ kha ṭāṃ cang te chang snod thogs pa nag po'i ming can rnal 'byor 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ nag po chen po mgon po mngon 'byung gi rgyud las/ yul u ru bi sha der skyes bu brtson 'grus dang ldan zhing sbyor ba la brtson pa/ rā ma ṇa'i bka'i 'jug pa dang mthun pa sde tshan dang po'i dang po bdun pa'i bzhi ba cung zad na la zhon pa skyes bu'i mchog 'dis ral gri la sogs pa'i dngos grub brgyad thob par 'gyur ro/

/'dzam bu'i gling du ma byung zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i slob ma drug gis lus kyi dngos po spangs pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /slob dpon 'di'i bla ma ni grub thob dza lan dha ra pa yin/ 'khrungs sa'i yul shar phyogs su u ru bi sha'o/ /yul dbus nā lan dar paṇḍi ta chen por gyur/ byang phyogs dzalandha rar bla ma dang mjal/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa sa g.yo ba dang brag la thogs pa med pa'i nus pa brnyes/ mkha' 'gro ma skal ba bzang mo'i phyag nas sambhu ṭa'i rgyud spyan drangs/ ḍa mi ḍo zhes bya ba 'gro lding yul du phra min pa thams cad btul zhing*/ de rnams kyi gtso mo srin mo sna tshogs gzugs zhes bya ba 'dzam bu gling pa'i skye bo mang po'i srog 'phrog pa zhig yod pa de 'dul bar byon/ dang por des 'khor mang po dang lhan cig 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis nam mkha' la 'ongs shing mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa la/ slob dpon gyis lta stangs mdzad pas sa la lhung zhing brgyal/ ting nge 'dzin gyis gzir dam 'og tu btsud pas de phyin chad 'byon pa na chibs dang*/ bzhugs pa na gdan du lus phul te gdug pa'i skye bo mang po skrag cing zil gyis gnon par mdzad pa dang*/ gdugs bdun 'dzin pa med par rang 'khor/ ḍa ma ru bdun 'khrol ba po med par rang 'khrol/ khru gang gis sa la ma reg par rtag tu 'byon/ dus rtag tu snang ba'i 'khor bdun brgya dang*/ mi snang ba'i 'khor bdun brgya dang*/ grub pa thob pa stong dang bzhi brgya'i 'khor gyis skor la/ yul gru chen po bcu gsum gyi skye bo thams cad rdo rje theg pa'i chos la bkod pas de thams cad rnal 'byor po mor gyur te grong khyer rnams stongs par gyur skad/ bla ma'i bka' cung zad bcag pas/ sku lus de la mchog gi dngos grub ma brnyes kyang*/ ral gri la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad thob/

bar dor sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang brnyes pa yin no/ /'di'i slob ma'i mchog drug ni/ e ya la dang*/ ma hi la dang*/ dha ma pa dang*/ dhu ma pa dang*/ bzang po'i zhabs dang*/ dge tshul tshem bu pa rnams so/ /slob dpon 'dis 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs dbang chog sbyin sreg ste bskyed rim gzhung gsum dang*/ dpyid kyi thig le dang rim pa bzhi pa dang*/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid de rdzogs rim gzhung gsum mo/ /de ltar na nag po gzhung drug tu grags so/ /spyir do ha rdo rje'i glu sogs bstan bcos phra mo brgya dang nyi shu tsam yod par grags/ bod du yang thor bu mang du 'gyur ro/ / brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad de yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams su byon zhing mu stegs grub thob kriṣṇa bhi ma dang katstsha'i rgyal po sogs btul/ shar phyogs bhang ga lar rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo thams cad mu stegs par yod pa/ he ru ka mnan pa'i dbang phyug gi bris sku/ dbang phyug mnan pa'i he ru kar song ba'i cho 'phrul bstan pas/ bhang ga la ba ril gyis sangs rgyas par song*/ grub pa'i slob dpon ches che ba'o/ /bde mchog gi chos skor khung ma rnams kyi nang nas lugs 'di rgyas shos yin/ phyis jo bo nā ro pa'i lugs 'di kho na gtso bor mdzad do/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i chos skor de rnams bod du byung tshul ni/ snga dar dus 'di ma 'gyur/ phyi dar gyi thog ma lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ laṅka rgyal bzang gi lugs dang*/ lū yi pa'i lugs dang*/ rin chen rdo rje'i lugs rnams bsgyur/ gzhan yang lo tsā ba 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer/ ma nang pa chos kyi shes rab/ mal blo gros grags pa/ mar pa chos kyi dbang phyugapu rangs lo chung grags 'byor shes rab/ rwa lo rdo rje grags/ klog skya lo tsā ba shes rab brtsegs/

ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags/ smon 'gro'i mar pa dang dar ma rdo rje/ 'dzim lo tsā ba/ bra bo lo tsā ba ste lo tsā bco lnga'i bde mchog rtsa rgyud bsgyur cing bshad/ de rnams kyi nang nas rwa lo mal mar do/ pu rangs lo chung ste lo tsā ba bzhi po 'dis lū dril nag gsum gyi man ngag dbang bka' rgyud bshad dang bcas pa shin tu dar bar mdzad cing*/ da lta'i bar du yang bzhugs pa yin/ bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i skor ni phyis gsum pa lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan gyis bsgyur ba yin no/ /kyai rdo rje'i rgyud ni rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa dang*/ de'i bshad rgyud du yang sbyor bar mdzad cing rgyud rgyas pa'i don bsdu lta bu'i rgyud rdo rje gur gnyis yin la/ rgya bod mang po zhig sambu ṭi yang kyai rdor gyi bshad rgyud du bzhed mod/ 'di ni bde mchog dang*/ kyai rdor dang*/ gdan bzhi gsum cha mnyam pa lta bu yin gyi kyai rdor kho na min no/ /dges rdor la rgya gar du grub thob mang du byon zhing*/ lugs srol mi 'dra ba'ang mang du yod par grags na'ang*/ slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje'i lugs/ mi thub zla ba'i lugs/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i lugs te gsum po mi 'dra ba che ba yod la/ gzhan nā ro mai tri sogs kyi lugs ni de gsum kas legs par bsdus pa lta bur yod do/ spyir bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs la ḍombhi he ru ka'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i 'od dang*/ yab dpa' bo lha dgu'i sgrub thabs la mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs de gnyis po 'di kyai rdor gyi gzhung snga shos so/ /bod du lha mnga' bdag ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis thog mar bsgyur/ gzhan yang lo tsā ba 'tshur dbyig gi snying po dang*/ rma ban chos 'bar la sogs pas kyang bsgyur zhing bshad mod kyi/ shin tu grags che ba ni 'brog 'gos mar gsum/ dpyal lo bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi lugs te rnam pa bzhi yin la/

de las dang po gsum da lta'i bar du yang rgyun mi chad pa yod/ gtso bor 'brog mi'i rjes 'brang sa chen yab sras la ḍombhi'i lugs/ man ngag lugs/ mtsho skyes lugs/ nag po lugs/ nā ro mai tri'i lugs te lugs srol drug byung*/ phyi ma gnyis da ltar chad/ gzhan rnams la bka' babs bzhi zhes pa lugs phyi rabs pa rnams zer/ 'gos lugs la mtsho skyes lugs dang*/ shanti pa'i lugs gnyis byung*/ mar lugs dang dpyal lugs gnyis ka nā ro pa'i rjes 'brang yin/ mar lugs la rngog lugs/ mes tshom po'i lugs/ 'tshur dbang gi rdo rje'i lugs te gsum byung ba las/ rngog lugs da lta'i bar du yod do/ /de la brtag gnyis las/ sku kyai rdo rje phyag gnyis/ gsung kyai rdo rje phyag bzhi pa/ thugs kyai rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ snying po dgyes zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ yum bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor rnams gsungs/ rdo rje gur las/ dges rdor rigs lnga so so dang*/ rigs bsdus dang*/ rdo rje sgrol ma sogs gsungs shing*/ gnyis ka nas ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs bshad/ sambu ṭi las/ kyai rdo rje mtshon cha can/ kha sbyor rdor sems kyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa gsungs/ sangs rgyas thod pa nas rgya gar du/ grub thob sa ra ha'i man ngag gi lugs dang*/ slob dpon a bha yā ka ra'i lugs gnyis byung zhing*/ bod du yang gyi lo tsā ba'i lugs dang*/ spong zho gsal ba grags kyi lugs gnyis dang*/ mar pa lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i dbang tsam yod/ mahā ma ya ni grub thob ku ku ri pa zhes bya bas spyan drangs/ des sgrub thabs la sogs pa bstan bcos drug mdzad/ slob dpon de nyid rgya gar du slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang*/ bod kyi rgyal po khri srong gi sku tshe'i stod dang dus dang mnyam/ rig ma khyi'i gzugs su bsgyur bas/ ku ku ri pa zhes pa khyi mo can du grags/ gzhan yang slob dpon 'dul bas byin dang*/

rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba la sogs pas kyang bka' srol mi 'dra ba re re dar bar mdzad/ bod du 'gos lo/ jo bo rje/ mar pa lo tsā rnams kyis bsgyur bshad dar bar mdzad cing*/ mar pa nas rngog pa las brgyud pa da lta'i bar du yang dar ro/ /phyag chen thig le sogs thig le'i skor ni/ dpal u rgyan gy-i gnas su rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti chung ba'i dus su dar/ lugs srol mi 'dra bar dgyes pa med/ bram ze rin chen rdo rje'i slob ma a tsa ra dmar por grags pa slob dpon shes rab gsang bas bod yul du gtsang rong gi lo tsā ba phyug mtshams dgra bcom la bshad/ de dang 'brog mi sogs kyis kyang bsgyur te/ rtsa rgyud phyag chen thig le dang phyogs mthun gyi rgyud gsum yod de/ ye shes thig le/ ye shes snying po/ rnal 'byor ma gsang ba'i sgron ma rnams so/ rgyud 'di rnams kyai rdor gyi rgyud du 'dod pa dag ni mi 'thad de/ phyag thig nyid las/ 'dus pa'am ni kyai rdo rje/ /der yang 'di ni ma bstan no/ /zhes kyai rdor las phyag chen thig le nyid lhag cing zab par bsngags brjod mdzad pas so/ /brjod bya ston tshul yang mi mtshungs pa cher yod cing*/ rgyud 'di bzhi las rtsa rlung thig le'i rnam gzhag shin tu zhib pa dang*/ sa lam mang po dang dbang gsum pa'i chags lam kho na rgyas par bshad do/ /rdo rje a ralli dang*/ ṛ gi a ralla'i rgyud ni grub thob ḍombhi he ru kas mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas spyan drangs/ bod yul du 'brog mis bsgyur/ dbang bshad man ngag gi bka' ni ma byung mod/ rgyud gzhan la ma ltos pa'i rang rkang pa re yin pa snga ma dges rdor dang mthun shas che la/ phyi ma bde mchog dang mthun shas che'o/ /mi g.yo ba bla med kyi rgyud gnyis kyang he ru ka'i rigs su bsdus na legs so/ /gsum pa rtag pa'i rigs ni bod du 'gyur ba gdan bzhi kho na yin la/ 'di la gdan bzhi rtsa rgyud/

bshad rgyud mant+ra aṃ sa dang sbyor ba'i rab dbye ste gnyis rgyud gsum yod/ rgya gar du rtsa rgyud la brten pa ārya de ba'i lugs dang*/ bsdus rgyud la brten pa slob dpon bha ba bha dra'i lugs gnyis gsal bar byung la/ bod du paṇḍi ta smṛ ta'i rang 'gyur gyi skor dang*/ 'gos khug pa'i lugs dang*/ lho brag mar pa'i lugs rnams byung*/ da lta yang dbang rgyud bshad man ngag rnams tshang bar bzhugs so/ /de ltar na mar pa la ni gsang 'dus 'phags skor dang*/ dges skor dang*/ ma hā ma ya dang*/ gdan bzhi'i chos skor rnams zab rgyas su bzhugs/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang rgyun tsam yod/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos skor ni rdzogs par mi bzhugs pas/ mar pa nas brgyud pa'i bde mchog gi skor yin zer ba rnams ni bod du gsar bcos yin par nges so/ /bzhi pa rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs kyi rgyud ni/ phyogs 'dir 'gyur ba rdo rje bdud rtsi kho na yin zhing*/ rgyud 'di grub thob bdud rtsi gsang bas mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas spyan drangs/ rgya gar du slob dpon dri med bzang po'i lugs dang*/ slob dpon bha go zhes pa skal ldan gyi lugs te gnyis byung*/ bod du dang po byung ba ni lo tsā ba lce btsan skyes kyis bsgyur/ phyis smṛ ti dang gyi co zla ba'i 'od zer gyis chos skor ci rigs bsgyur/ da lta rdo rje 'phreng ba'i nang gi dbang rgyun tsam zhig bzhugs/ lnga pa padma gar dbang gi rigs la/ padma gar dbang nyid kyi rtog pa ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba dang*/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud yar lung lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur/ drug pa rta'i rgyal po'i rigs kyi rgyud ni sngon snga dar gyi dus su dpal bdun pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i rgyud 'gyur te/ da lta bka' sogs med/ sgrol ma'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig dang*/ phur pa rtsa dum sogs kyang rigs 'di'i nang tshan yin zhing*/

mgon po mngon byung gi rgyun kyang 'phrin las kyi rigs yin pas phyogs 'dir bsdu/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba gsar du bsgyur pa 'di ni grub thob rol pa'i rdo rje dang log pra da gnyis kyis sgrub thabs so sor mdzad pas lugs mi 'dra ba gnyis yod cing*/ phyis grub pa'i dbang phyug zhi ba sbas pas dar bar mdzad de/ slob dpon pa ba dyā nā tha dang*/ buddha gupta nā tha dang*/ purṇa badzra ste gsum las 'jam mgon tā ra nā thas gsan zhing bsgyur bar mdzad pa yin/ rgyud 'di las sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ dbugs dbyung drug la sogs pa dkyil 'khor yang mang du 'byung zhing*/ rdzogs rim rgyas par bshad do/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi dbye ba rnams bshad nas/ de dag gi lam gyi rim pa ni gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma las/ rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras rgyud gsum mo/ /dang po rgyu rgyud ni sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal pa gdod ma nas bde ba dang stong pa dang gsal ba zung 'jug tu gnas pa de yin pas lam yang bde ba dang*/ stong pa dang lha sku gsal bar bsgoms pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i dus su yang stong pa chos kyi sku dang*/ bde ba longs sku dang*/ gsal ba dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sprul sku ste/ sku gsum thob tu rung ba'i nus mthu can sems la sku gsum sa bon gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa thabs rgyud ni smin grol gnyis te/ smin byed kyi dbang la dbang bzhi tshang ba ste/ de yang dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro ba yin la/ bum dbang gi dkyil 'khor ni rdul tshon dang ras bris dang lus dkyil gsum gsal bar gsungs shing*/ blos slangs la sogs pa yang don gyis thob pa yin/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor de dag bdag mdun dbyer med dam tha dad gang rung gi sgo nas sgrubs shing mchod dgos pa yin la/

dbang bskur ba ni/ phyi nang gi 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas/ chu cod pan/ rdo rje dril bu/ ming ste rig pa'i dbang lnga dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ rjes gnang dang*/ lung bstan dang*/ dbugs dbyung dang*/ gzengs bstod de/ de rnams bum dbang yin la/ rjes gsang ba/ byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang dang*/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes dang*/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa rnams bskur ba yin/ yang dus kyi 'khor lo las ni/ byis 'jug bdun dang*/ dbang gong ma bzhi gsungs te/ chu dang*/ cod pan dang*/ dar dpyangs dang*/ rdor dril dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ ming dang*/ rjes gnang ste/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun no/ /dbang gong ma la slob ma'i dbang gong ma dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang dang*/ slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang te gsum po de dag re re la'ang bum gsang shes rab bzhi pa rnams su phye bas bcu gnyis su 'gyur la/ 'di skabs kyi bum dbang ni gzhan gyi bum dbang dang mi gcig ste/ bum pa zhes pa brdas bstan pa yin pas phyag rgya'i lus mtshon pa yin/ des na phyag rgya'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum dbang zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad/ gzhan rnams spyi 'gros dang gnad gcig pa yin no/ /de ltar na bla med kyi rgyud sde 'dir khams gsum dkyil 'khor du dag pa dang gnyis sbyor 'od gsal lam du byed pa rgyas par bshad do/ /gnyis pa grol byed kyi lam la bskyed rim ni brdzus skyes dang mtshungs pa skad cig gis bskyed pa dang*/ drod gsher skyes dang mtshungs par sa bon phyag mtshan las bskyed pa dang*/ sgong skyes dang mtshungs pa mngon par byang chub lnga las bskyed pa dang*/ mngal skyes dang mtshungs pa zhu ba glus bskul dang*/ mkha' nang nas spro ba sogs yin cing*/ mngon rtogs tshar gcig la 'chi ba dang bar do dang*/ skye ba gsum sbyang ba'i thabs tshang ba/

chos longs sprul gsum lam du byed nus pa cig dgos te/ de yang lha gtso bo bskyed pa dang po sbyor ba/ 'khor tshogs spro ba dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dag pa dran pa dang*/ phra thig bsgom pa sogs las rgyal mchog ste/ ting nge 'dzin gsum tshang ba'am/ bsnyen pa/ nye sgrub/ sgrub pa/ sgrub chen te bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi tshang pa'i/ rnal 'byor/ rjes su rnal 'byor/ shin tu rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor chen po ste rnal 'byor bzhi cha tshang ba gang rung zhig dgos/ bskyed rim gyi yan lag tu bzlas pa dang gtor ma gnyis/ kha zas dang rjes chags gnyis/ nyal ba dang ldang ba dang gnyis/ spyod lam dang mchod pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis te rnal 'byor brgyad po de rnams dgos la/ sbyin sreg dang 'khor lo'i mchod pa sogs la'ang bslab par bya'o/ /rdzogs rim ni klu sgrub yab sras kyi bzhed pas rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim pa/ sems la dmigs pa'i rim pa/ bdag byin rlabs pa'i rim pa/ mngon par byang chub kyi rim pa/ zung 'jug gi rim pa ste rim pa lngar bzhed la/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs ni snying gar mi shigs pa'i thig le/ gsang bar rdzas kyi thig le/ sna sgor sprul pa'i thig le/ chos nyid ye shes kyi thig le ste thig le'i rnal 'byor bzhir 'dus par bzhed la/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa'i bzhed pa ni/ bdag byin rlabs pa'i rim pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa/ nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa/ dza landha ra'i rim pa/ bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa ste bde mchog rim lngar grags pa ltar yin/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa ni rgyud kyi rim pa/ sngags kyi rim pa/ ye shes kyi rim pa/ gsang ba'i rim pa ste rim pa bzhi lam thams cad bsdus par bzhed do/ /dus 'khor dang gzhan yang rgyud mang por/ /so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang*/ /srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*/ /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug tu 'dod/

/ces rnal 'byor yan lag drug gis bsdus par bzhed do/ /thams cad mthun par/ gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi rtsa dang*/ rlung dang*/ thig le'i rnal 'byor shes nas dmigs pa dang*/ rlung sbyor dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi sgo nas rang lus rtsa dbu ma la gnad du bsnun pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems kunda lta bu dbab bzung bzlog khyab kyi rim pas rjes chags kyi dga' ba bzhi ngos 'dzin pa gzhan lus shes rab kyi lam dang*/ lus ngag gi rtsol ba dang*/ yid rnam rtog gis ma brtags par stong gzugs phyag rgya chen pos mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen 'dres pa ste rdzogs rim thams cad kyang gsum du 'dus so/ /de ltar bskyed rdzogs rim pa gnyis la brtan pa thob pa na/ brtul zhugs kyi spyad pa spyod dgos pa las/ de la dbye na spros bcas spros med/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa gsum mam/ yang na kun 'dar/ kun bzang*/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa ste gsum du yod do/ /brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i ngo bo ni sems bde ba chen por shar ba dang rkyen las kyi phyag rgya sogs bsten pa'i bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin gcig gi steng du/ phyi bde sdug gi snang ba thams cad ro mnyam du bsre ba yin la/ de ltar spyod pa la brten nas dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa 'bras bu rgyud la thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub gnyis las/ thun mong la phra mo'i chung ngu las rim sna tshogs ni zhi rgyas dbang dgug bsad bskrad dbye mnan te las chen brgyad la sogs pa'o/ /'bring rdzas kyi dngos grub ni sa 'og dang*/ ral gri dang*/ ril bu dang*/ mig sman dang*/ rkang mgyogs dang*/ bcud len dang*/ ro langs dang*/ gter gyi dngos grub ste dngos grub brgyad do/ /chen po las kyi rig 'dzin ni/ 'dod khams kyi lha'i gzugs khams kyi lha dang bskal ba mnyam pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po'o/ /gnyis pa mchog gi dngos grub la gnas skabs su sngags kyi lam la brten nas 'phags pa'i sa thob pa zung 'jug gi sku dang*/

mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grub pa gnyis so/ /sangs rgyas ni sku bzhi ye shes lnga 'phrin las dang bcas pas bsdus pa'o/ /chos longs sprul gsum gyi steng du bde ba chen po'i sku bsnan pa ni sku bzhi dang*/ chos dbyings me long mnyam nyid sor rtog bya ba sgrub ste ye shes lnga dang*/ 'phrin las ni theg pa gzhan du bshad pa dang thun mong pa yang yod/ rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor sprul bshad sogs thun mong ma yin pa yang yod do/ /de thams cad bsdu na yan lag bdun dang*/ dbang phyug brgyad du 'du/ ji skad du/ slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas yan lag bdun pa'i gzhung du/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med/ /ces yan lag bdun no/ /gsang 'dus kyi 'grel chen sgron gsal las/ rgyud rgyas pa'i lung drangs pa na/ sku yi dbang phyug dang ni gsung gi dbang phyug dang*/ /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang*/ /rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro gnas kyi dbang phyug dang*/ /ci 'dod byed dang yon tan brgyad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te phyi ma gnyis ni 'dod pa'i dbang phyug dang*/ yon tan gyi dbang phyug ces bya'o/ /de ltar na rdo rje theg pa'i gnas lugs gsal byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mkhas grub du ma'i gtsug rgyan 'jam mgon kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rdo rje'i gsung las byon pa dgas la spyod pa'i dbang phyug rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che bla na bkur ba dang 'gro ba kun la phan bde'i dpal yon rtag tu sbyin pa'i snying stobs can kun dga' rab brtan dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya bas gsar du bsgrigs pa'i dge ba 'dis kyang skye dgu mtha' dag zab lam rdo rje theg pa'i spyod pa'i skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig
/zhus dag/ //maṅga laṃ//
